description: Expand Dashboard, Users, and Institutions pages with comprehensive sections, detailed statistics, time-range filters, performance metrics, and enhanced tables. These three pages form the core of admin oversight and need rich data visualization
steps: Expand AdminDashboardPage in src/pages/Admin/Dashboard/AdminDashboardPage.jsx: Add welcome section with current date and quick platform summary, expand platform statistics to 8 cards (total reports, new reports, in progress, resolved, active institutions, registered citizens, active staff, fallback queue), add time-range filter (7/30/90 days) for report analytics charts, add institutional performance table with columns (institution name, total reports, new, in progress, resolved, avg resolution time, performance indicator), expand recent activity to show 8-10 entries with actor avatars

Expand mockAdminData.js: Add institutional performance metrics (avgResolutionTime per institution, performance scores), add 10 more recent activity entries, add time-series data for report analytics (submissions per day for last 90 days), add staff activity summary

Expand UsersPage in src/pages/Admin/Users/UsersPage.jsx: Add summary cards for total users, citizens, staff, admins, active users, inactive users. Expand user table columns to include: avatar/initials, name, email, phone (add to mockUsers), role badge, institution, account status badge, registration date, last active date (add to mockUsers), actions menu. Add bulk actions toolbar (when users selected): activate/deactivate multiple, export selected. Add user details modal showing: profile info, account status, assigned permissions (add permissions array to mockUsers), institution affiliation, recent activity, login history
Expand mockUsers in src/data/mockAdminData.js: Add 15 more users (mix of citizens, staff, admins), add phone, lastActiveAt, permissions array, loginHistory array fields

Expand InstitutionsPage in src/pages/Admin/Institutions/InstitutionsPage.jsx: Add summary cards for total, active, inactive institutions, institutions with pending reports. Expand institution table columns: name, type, contact person (add to mockInstitutions), contact email/phone, service areas badges (first 2 + count), staff count, assigned reports, resolved reports, avg resolution time (add to mockInstitutions), status badge, creation date, actions. Add institution details modal with tabs: Overview (basic info), Contact (full contact details), Staff (list of staff members from that institution), Service Areas (all assigned areas), Routing (routing rules targeting this institution), Reports (recent reports), Activity (recent changes)

Expand mockInstitutions in src/data/mockAdminData.js: Add 3 more institutions (education department, health services, traffic management), add contactPerson, avgResolutionTime, recentReports array, activityLog array fields
Create InstitutionDetailsModal component in src/pages/Admin/Institutions/InstitutionDetailsModal.jsx: Tabbed modal showing comprehensive institution information
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays 8 summary cards with correct data from mockAdminData
Dashboard time-range filter updates chart data when changed
Dashboard institutional performance table shows all institutions with performance metrics
UsersPage summary cards show correct counts based on filtered data
UsersPage table includes all specified columns with proper formatting
User details modal opens when clicking a user row and displays all user information
InstitutionsPage summary cards show correct institution statistics
InstitutionsPage table displays all columns including avg resolution time
Institution details modal opens with working tabs showing relevant data from mockAdminData
verification: Run npm run dev and navigate to /admin - verify 8 stat cards, time filter, performance table, expanded activity
Change time-range filter on dashboard - chart data should update
Navigate to /admin/users - verify summary cards, expanded table with all columns
Click a user row - details modal should open with tabs and user data
Navigate to /admin/institutions - verify summary cards and expanded table
Click an institution row - details modal should open with all tabs working
Check browser console for errors - should be clean
